description: This script automates database management tasks for OpenMRS, including dropping and creating the database and updating it using Liquibase snapshots. It is intended for development or testing purposes, not production.

methods.name: drop_and_create_database
methods.description: Drops existing OpenMRS database and creates a new one using provided MySQL credentials.

methods.name: update_database
methods.description: Runs Maven commands to update the database schema and data using specified Liquibase changelog files.

methods.name: echo_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.
